name: io.github.hammasbuilds/repo-recon
title: Repo Recon
description: Reads an unfamiliar Python codebase from its AST. Writes nothing; runs only git log and git diff.

environmentVariables.name: REPO_RECON_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: A directory every path argument must sit under. Optional, and worth setting: a filesystem path is this server's only input, so this is the one thing worth bounding. Without it, any readable path on the machine can be analysed.

environmentVariables.name: REPO_RECON_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: A file to append one JSON line to per tool call, for the console in observability/. Optional and off by default: unset, this server writes nothing at all. Set, it writes this one file - counts, rates and durations, never a path, a symbol or a commit message. Deleting the file is a complete uninstall.
